COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No.1195 of 2024
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Vinod Fulara, learned counsel for the
petitioners, through video conferencing.
2. Mr. Sachin Mohan Singh Mehta, learned Brief
Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for the
Commission/respondent no.8, through video
conferencing.
4. This writ petition has been filed by the
petitioners seeking a writ of mandamus commanding
respondents to declare the petitioners as successful
candidates pursuant to the selection on the posts of
Patwari/Lekhpal-2022, due to non-joining of candidates
from the select list.
5. It is case of the petitioners that pursuant to the
Advertisement No.A-1/E-5/DR/RSI/2022-23 dated
10.10.2022 petitioners participated in the selection
process. The written selection exam was held on
12.02.2023 while the result of the written examination
was declared on 06.05.2023. The petitioners were not
successful in the written examination and their names
were not found in the select list.
6. It is contended by learned counsel for the
petitioners that many of the persons from the select list
failed to join and therefore the vacancies left due to
their non-joining which may be accommodated with the

2
petitioners.
7. It is further contended by learned counsel for the
petitioners that petitioners want respondent to prepare a
waiting list and the benefit of the selection be given to
the petitioners. This Court is not impressed with the
submission made by learned counsel for the petitioner.
8. There is no dispute regarding this fact that the
select list, in which the petitioners do not even fall, was
issued on 06.07.2023 and the life of a select list is one
year and in that view of the matter also the petitioners
have no claim.
9. Accordingly, writ petition is dismissed in-limine.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 22.07.2024
